title: Switching an output on and off permanently
body_md: An output can be switched on until further notice by text message and switched off again the same way. Pro-finder carries out the switching operation and replies with a status report each time.
prev_context: The introduction to 5.5 ends on the previous page.
change_reason: Extracted from the English source page itself, not translated from the German master, and cross-read against the German page 23: equivalent in substance, including the feedback by status report. The two command strings are not reproduced (BLK-005).
